title: Optimal Private Gaussian Multi-sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.30146v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We give polynomial-time algorithms for Gaussian multi-sampling under approximate $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-differential privacy, with optimal sample complexity up to logarithmic factors. Our main construction uses $\widetilde{O}(m+d\sqrt{m}/\varepsilon)$ independent input samples from a $d$-dimensional Gaussian $P$ with unknown mean and covariance to generate $m$ exactly independent outputs. Their joint distribution is $\alpha$-close in total variation to $P^{\otimes m}$. Our lower bounds hold even for dependent outputs under the same joint accuracy guarantee, showing that exact independence incurs no additional sample cost beyond logarithmic factors.   The single-sampler of Iverson, Kamath, and Mouzakis [COLT 2025] uses $\widetilde{O}(d/\varepsilon)$ input samples. translated_title: 最优隐私保护高斯多重采样
translated_abstract: 在近似 $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-差分隐私约束下，我们给出了高斯多重采样的多项式时间算法，其样本复杂度在对数因子意义下达到最优。我们的主要构造利用来自均值为未知、协方差未知的 $d$ 维高斯分布 $P$ 的 $\widetilde{O}(m+d\sqrt{m}/\varepsilon)$ 个独立输入样本，生成 $m$ 个完全独立的输出，且这些输出的联合分布在全变差距离下与 $P^{\otimes m}$ 相差不超过 $\alpha$。我们的下界结果即使在允许输出相互依赖且满足相同联合精度保证的情形下依然成立，这表明生成完全独立的输出除了对数因子外并不会带来额外的样本代价。Iverson、Kamath 和 Mouzakis [COLT 2025] 的单样本采样器使用 $\widetilde{O}(d/\varepsilon)$ 个输入样本，若为 $m$ 个输出中的每一个分别在独立的输入数据集上运行该采样器，总代价将达到 $\widetilde{O}(md/\varepsilon)$。我们的构造降低了这一随维度增长的样本复杂度……
tldr: 该论文提出了在近似差分隐私下样本复杂度最优（至对数因子）的高斯多重采样多项式时间算法，仅需 $\widetilde{O}(m+d\sqrt{m}/\varepsilon)$ 个输入样本即可生成 $m$ 个完全独立、联合分布逼近真实高斯乘积分布的输出，显著优于逐个采样所需的 $\widetilde{O}(md/\varepsilon)$ 样本代价。
en_tdlr: This paper presents polynomial-time algorithms for Gaussian multi-sampling under approximate differential privacy with optimal sample complexity up to logarithmic factors, generating $m$ exactly independent outputs whose joint distribution is close to $P^{\otimes m}$ using only $\widetilde{O}(m+d\sqrt{m}/\varepsilon)$ samples, substantially improving upon the $\widetilde{O}(md/\varepsilon)$ cost of naive per-output sampling.
